༄༅/ /phyag rgya chen po'i lta sgom spyod gsum gyi nyams su len tshul zhal gdams gser zhun ma bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// phyag rgya chen po'i lta sgom spyod gsum gyi nyams su len tshul zhal gdams gser zhun ma bzhugs so//

༄༅// na mo gu ru pra bha kā ra ye/ skyabs gnas bslu med kun 'dus 'brug pa rje// da ni mi 'bral rgyun du gsol ba 'debs// khyed chos la bag chags byed "$ pa rnams// snying nas chos 'brel tshig gsum zhu// spyir mi lus thob pa da res tsam// sgos sdom gsum ldan pa shin tu dkon// lus 'di 'dra thob pa'i dus 'di ru// chos rnam dag 'bad par ma byas na// lus 'di 'dra phyis nas mi rnyed pas// dus 'di la phyag dang bskor ba mdzod// dgra 'chi bdag gshin rje khad btsan po// kho nam yong tig tig mi 'dug pas// chos byed bsam yod kyang 'chi bas gtug /khyed da ni sdig spongs dge ba sgrubs// gnas ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal de// tshig rna bas thos kyang blo snying 'dar// 'di thog tu byung na ji ltar byed// de soms la sdig pa dug ltar 'dzem// gnas thar med 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// skyob nus par byed pa dkon mchog gsum// khyed mi 'bral snying nas gsol ba thob// ma 'gro drug sems can thams cad kun// sngon tshe rabs mang po'i pha ma yin// 'di 'khor ba'i gnas su sdug re bsngal// chos ci byed 'gro ba'i don la bsngo// rje mtshan ldan bla ma spyi bor bsgom// snying rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba 'debs/ de 'od zhu rang gi sems dang bsre// de ma bcos rang gi sems la ltos// lar phyi nang gsang gsum gar 'gro ltos// sems ma bcos de yi ngang la zhog /sems yod pa ma yin dngos po med// med pa ma yin ci yang dran// sems res 'ga' gnas te res 'ga' 'gro// khyed sems la bya ra rgyun du mdzod// sems ngo bo stong par 'dug pa de// sems chos sku snang ba mtha' yas yin// sems rang bzhin 'od du gsal ba de// sems longs sku thugs rje chen po yin// sems rnam rtog ci yang 'phro ba de// sems sprul sku padma 'byung gnas yin// sems dug lnga'i rtog pa ci shar yang*// ngo shes na rgyal ba rigs lnga yin// sems gsal na gsal ba'i ngo bor ltos// gsal stong phyag rgya chen po yin// sems bde na bde ba'i ngo bor ltos// bde stong rdzogs pa chen po yin/

sems stong na stong pa'i rang zhal ltos// rig stong dbu ma chen po yin// sems skrag na skrag mkhan ngo bor ltos// de dam chos bdud kyi gcod yul yin// sems dngos po ci yang ma mthong na// sems stong nyid shes rab phar phyin yin// khyed 'gro zhing 'dug cing sems la ltos// 'gro 'dug don dam gyi bskor ba yin// bza' zhing btung zhing sems la ltos// bza' btung zag med kyi tshogs 'khor yin// khyed nyal zhing gnyid cing sems la ltos// gnyid 'od gsal zin pa'i gdams ngag yin// khyed zab mo'i bsnyen sgrub byed pa'i dus// don zab mo rang gi sems la ltos// bdud bar chad bzlog na de yis bzlog /dus da lta 'phral du gang dran yang*// phugs sgom yun shi dang mnyam par gyis// mi mang po'i gtam dang ltad mo dang*// sems bslu ba'i bya ba gang sgrub kyang*// der yengs pa'i dbang du ma song ba// sgom zab mo gnad kyi nyams len yin// de ma brjed tu re dran par gyis// dran thog nas rang tsho thub par mdzod// der yang yang rang dbang 'dus pa yi// sgom nyams len 'dris goms red par gyis// don de la goms yun ring ba na// sgom thun mtshams 'khor yug rgyun chad med// chu bo'i gzhung 'dra ba rgyun du 'byung ba'i rten 'brel yin// karma bstan 'phel gyi skyes mtha' khams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin dge legs dpal bzang po'i zhal gdams gser zhun ma 'dra ba ser skya pho mo skal pa dang ldan pa rnams la gdams pa'o// //
